Muktijuddher Bijoy Mela in Ctg celebrates silver jubilee
2013-12-25T00:00:22+06:00 | Staff Correspondent, Ctg
https://www.thedailystar.net/muktijuddher-bijoy-mela-in-ctg-celebrates-silver-jubilee-3897

The Muktijuddher Bijoy Mela, held annually commemorating the month of victory, in Chittagong celebrated its silver jubilee this year. The 16-day long fair, which began on December 10, ends today. Bijoy Mela was first held in the port city in 1989. Held at Chittagong city's Outer Stadium, the fair includes entertainment shows including a 'Bijoy Mancha', a platform for programmes on the country's Liberation War. Traders have also set up many stalls at the fair selling locally-made products. Muktijuddher Bijoy Mela Udjapan Parishad organises the fair. ABM Mohiuddin Chowdhury, the chairman of the parishad and president of city unit Awami League, inaugurated the fair on December 10. Faruk-e-Azam Bir Protik, convener of the first Bijoy Mela in 1989, expressed his happiness at the fair's silver jubilee. “When we initiated the fair in Chittagong to mark the victory of our Liberation War, it was the first of its kind in the country,” he said, adding, “Following our initiative, the Bijoy Mela is also being organised elsewhere in the country.” Some youths who were born on December 19, 1971 inaugurated the first Bijoy Mela on December 11, 1989, he said.
